price.a: Nichts. Ankora ist kostenlos, es gibt kein kostenpflichtiges Angebot, und keine Funktion ist einem höheren Tarif vorbehalten. Diese Zusage steht in den Nutzungsbedingungen, nicht nur hier.

bank.q: Pourquoi une deuxième app alors que j'ai déjà celle de ma banque ?
bank.a: L'app de ta banque te montre ton solde — ce qui s'est déjà passé. Elle ne te dit pas que l'assurance du 15 et la taxe de novembre sont déjà promises. Ankora tient ce registre-là : ce qui est déjà engagé, compté d'avance, pour que le chiffre que tu lis soit celui que tu peux vraiment dépenser. Et Ankora ne se connecte jamais à ta banque — aucune donnée n'est lue sur ton compte : c'est toi qui saisis tes chiffres.

advice.a: Nein. Ankora ist ein Tool für Budgetorganisation und finanzielle Bildung. Es bietet keine Anlageempfehlungen oder personalisierte Finanzberatung.

storage.a: Deine Daten werden in der Europäischen Union gehostet (Supabase, EU-Region) mit Verschlüsselung im Ruhezustand und strikter Nutzer-Isolation über Row Level Security.

sharing.a: Standardmäßig ist dein Bereich zu 100 % privat. Optionale geteilte Töpfe (Reise, gemeinsames Projekt) kommen in einer nächsten Version — du entscheidest ausdrücklich, was du teilst und mit wem.

faq.metaDescription: Häufige Fragen zu Ankora: Sicherheit, Daten, Funktionsweise, Datenschutz.
faq.title: Häufige Fragen
faq.subtitle: Alles, was du über Ankora wissen musst, bevor du loslegst.

bankConnection.q: Verbindet sich Ankora mit meiner Bank?
bankConnection.a: Nein. Ankora nutzt die PSD2-Richtlinie nicht. Du trägst deine Fixkosten und Ausgaben manuell ein. Diese Wahl stellt sicher, dass du Eigentümer deiner Daten bleibst und keine sensiblen Bankinformationen gespeichert werden.

dataLocation.a: Alle deine Daten werden in der Europäischen Union gehostet (Supabase EU-Region, Vercel EU-Region, Upstash EU). Es findet keine Übertragung außerhalb der EU statt.

smoothing.a: Ankora nimmt deine vierteljährlichen, halbjährlichen und jährlichen Fixkosten und verteilt sie auf 12 Monate. So weißt du, wie viel du jeden Monat zurücklegen musst, um alle zukünftigen Rechnungen stressfrei zu decken.

deletion.a: Ja, jederzeit unter Einstellungen → Datenschutz. Die Löschung wird 14 Tage nach deinem Antrag wirksam (du kannst sie in diesem Zeitraum widerrufen). Alle deine Finanzdaten werden gelöscht, die Sicherheitslogs werden pseudonymisiert.

export.a: Ja. Die Schaltfläche „Meine Daten herunterladen“ in den Einstellungen liefert dir eine JSON-Datei mit deinem Profil, deinen Budgets, Fixkosten, Ausgaben, Kategorien, Einwilligungen und deinem Aktivitätsprotokoll. Wir erweitern diesen Export mit jeder Version (DSGVO-Recht auf Datenübertragbarkeit, Art. 20).

advice.a: Nein. Ankora ist ein Tool für Budgetbildung und Organisation. Wir geben keine Anlageberatung (regulatorische Einschränkung FSMA Belgien). Für jede Anlageentscheidung wende dich an eine zugelassene Fachperson.

ai.a: In Phase 1 nein. Die Berechnungen sind deterministisch und auditierbar. In Phase 2 ermöglicht dir eine optionale BYOK-Schicht (Bring Your Own Key), deinen eigenen Anthropic- oder OpenRouter-Schlüssel für Vorschläge zu verbinden — ohne Mehrkosten auf Ankora-Seite.

sharing.q: Kann ich meinen Bereich mit meinen Kindern oder Freunden teilen?
sharing.a: In Phase 1 hat jeder Nutzer einen privaten, standardmäßig isolierten Bereich. In Phase 2 fügen wir die Möglichkeit hinzu, „geteilte Töpfe“ zu erstellen (per Einladung, mit Viewer/Editor-Rollen), ohne jemals deine persönlichen Daten zu vermischen.

cgu.metaDescription: AGB von Ankora — Regeln für die Nutzung des Dienstes.
cgu.title: Allgemeine Nutzungsbedingungen

s1.heading: 1. Zweck
s1.body: Ankora ist ein Tool für Budgetorganisation und finanzielle Bildung für Privatpersonen. Es ermöglicht, Fixkosten und Ausgaben manuell einzutragen, sie über das Jahr zu verteilen und den Liquiditätsbedarf vorauszuplanen.

s2.heading: 2. Was Ankora NICHT ist
s2.item1: Ankora ist kein Dienst für Anlage- oder Investitionsberatung.
s2.item2: Ankora ist kein Bankdienst und hält keine Gelder.
s2.item3: Ankora ist kein PSD2-Aggregator — keine Verbindung zu deinen Bankkonten.
s2.outro: Die angezeigten Informationen sind Schätzungen auf Basis deiner Eingaben. Sie stellen keine personalisierte Finanzberatung dar. Für wichtige Entscheidungen wende dich an eine zugelassene Fachperson.

s3.heading: 3. Konto
s3.item1: Du musst volljährig sein oder die Zustimmung eines gesetzlichen Vertreters haben.
s3.item4: Du bist für die Vertraulichkeit deiner Zugangsdaten verantwortlich.

s4.heading: 4. Akzeptable Nutzung
s4.item1: den Dienst für illegale Zwecke zu nutzen,
s4.item3: den Zugriff ohne ausdrückliche Erlaubnis zu automatisieren,
s4.item4: dein Konto mit Dritten zu teilen.

s5.heading: 5. Geistiges Eigentum
s5.body: Du bleibst Eigentümer deiner Daten. Ankora behält das Eigentum an seinem Code, seiner Marke, seinem Design und seiner Dokumentation.

s6.heading: 6. Haftung
s6.body: Ankora wird „wie besehen“ bereitgestellt. Der Herausgeber kann nicht für Finanzentscheidungen verantwortlich gemacht werden, die auf Grundlage der angezeigten Informationen getroffen werden. Keine Garantie für 100 % Verfügbarkeit.

s7.heading: 7. Kündigung
s7.body: Du kannst dein Konto jederzeit unter Einstellungen → Datenschutz löschen. Die Löschung wird 14 Tage nach dem Antrag wirksam (widerrufbare Frist).

s8.heading: 8. Kostenlosigkeit des Dienstes
s8.body: Ankora ist kostenlos. Es gibt kein kostenpflichtiges Angebot, und keine Funktion ist einem höheren Tarif vorbehalten. Sollte jemals ein kostenpflichtiges Angebot eingeführt werden, behalten Konten, die vor dessen Start erstellt wurden, den vollständigen Zugang zum Kern-Cockpit kostenlos. Diese Zusage steht hier, damit sie uns vertraglich und nicht nur werblich bindet.
s8.donations: Sollten jemals freiwillige Spenden angeboten werden, begründen sie keinerlei Gegenleistung: keine Funktion, keinen vorzeitigen Zugang, keinen Supportvorrang. Eine Spende ändert nichts an dem in diesen Bedingungen beschriebenen Verhältnis.

s9.heading: 9. Anwendbares Recht
s9.body: Diese AGB unterliegen belgischem Recht. Zuständiges Gericht: Brüssel.

privacy.metaDescription: Ankora's privacy policy: data controller, data collected, services used, transfers and rights.
privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.languageNotice: Diese Richtlinie ist vorerst nur auf Französisch und Englisch verfügbar.
privacy.intro: The text below is made of sourced legal sentences, which we have not rewritten: that is why it is more formal than the rest of Ankora.

controller.heading: Data controller
controller.p1: The data controller is Ankora, published by Thierry Vanmeeteren.
controller.p3: Requests you send to this address about your personal data are processed there in order to answer you.
controller.p4: This processing is necessary for compliance with a legal obligation: the regulation requires the controller to facilitate the exercise of your rights and to answer your requests.
controller.p5: These messages are kept for as long as necessary to handle your request.

data.heading: Data collected
data.p1: Hosting this site produces technical logs, which contain in particular the IP address from which the pages are viewed.
data.p2: The publisher consults these logs for the security of the service: detecting abuse and intrusion attempts, and diagnosing incidents.
data.p3: This processing is necessary for the purposes of the legitimate interests pursued by the publisher, namely the security of the service: detecting abuse and intrusion attempts, and diagnosing incidents (Article 6(1)(f)).
data.p4: These logs are kept for twelve months at most, and pseudonymised as soon as the account is deleted.

account.heading: user account
account.p1: This data is used to create and manage your account, and to give you access to it.
account.p2: This processing is necessary for the performance of the contract to which you are party, or for steps taken at your request prior to entering into it (Article 6(1)(b)).
account.p3: This data is kept for as long as the account exists.
account.p4: Providing this data is a condition for creating the account: without it, the account cannot be opened.

content.heading: content uploaded by the user
content.p1: This data is used to host the content you upload and to return it to you.
content.p2: This processing is necessary for the performance of the contract to which you are party, or for steps taken at your request prior to entering into it (Article 6(1)(b)).
content.p3: This data is kept until you delete it.

audience.heading: audience measurement
audience.p1: This data is used to measure how the application is used.
audience.p2: This processing is based on your consent (Article 6(1)(a) GDPR).
audience.p3: This data is kept for six months.

supabase.heading: Supabase — database
supabase.p2: Storing the application’s data and serving the requests that read, modify or delete it, for the development and operation of the application.
supabase.p3: (DPA, Schedule 3: nature of the processing “Storage, deletion, rectification, analysis, transfer, aggregation”; purpose “The performance of the Services, namely the provision of database and tooling services for the development and operation of web and mobile applications”.)
supabase.p4: Data transmitted: The data the application records, as it sends it, as well as the login credentials of the accounts the application opens for its users.
supabase.p5: (DPA, definition of “Covered Data” (a): the data provided by the customer.)
supabase.p6: Sub-processors: Amazon Web Services, Inc; Cloudflare, Inc; Google, LLC; Fly.io, Inc; Vercel, Inc; Upstash, Inc
supabase.p7: The provider declares other providers — support, technical monitoring, feature enablement, error tracking, data analysis, security, artificial intelligence — without specifying which of them receive this data.
supabase.p8: It declares others whose purpose relates to its own operations — status page, customer knowledge, marketplace.
supabase.p9: The data is stored and mainly processed in the region chosen by the customer, which does not remove the transfer described below.
supabase.p10: The data is transferred outside the European Union, on the basis of: standard contractual clauses (Decision 2021/914).
supabase.p12: List published by the provider — <url>https://supabase.com/legal/customer-resources/subprocessor-list</url>, updated on 2026-06-01

vercel.heading: Vercel — hosting
vercel.p2: Hosting the application and serving its pages, including building, deployment and distribution over the edge network.
vercel.p3: (Privacy Notice, “About Vercel Products and Services”: “a frontend cloud for deploying and scaling frontend applications”.)
vercel.p4: Data transmitted: IP address and system configuration information, as well as any content the deployment transmits.
vercel.p5: (DPA, Schedule 1 §5: “such as IP address and system configuration information”, the scope being “exclusively determined and controlled by the Customer”.)
vercel.p6: Sub-processors: Amazon Web Services (AWS); Google; Microsoft
vercel.p7: The provider declares other providers — technical monitoring, security, debugging, logging, search, notification, data analysis, data storage, artificial intelligence — without specifying which of them receive this data.
vercel.p8: The data is transferred outside the European Union, on the basis of: EU–US Data Privacy Framework.
vercel.p9: The provider is not only a processor of this data. It also processes it for purposes of its own, in particular: providing the service and administering the account; customer support; platform security; legal compliance and trust. For this processing, it acts as a controller.
vercel.p10: List published by the provider — <url>https://security.vercel.com</url>, updated on 2026-01-28

upstash.heading: Upstash — security
upstash.p2: Declared by the site publisher; Publiable has not checked this service’s documentation.

analytics.heading: Vercel Web Analytics — audience measurement
analytics.p1: Data transmitted: your IP address, the technical characteristics of your device and browser, the pages you view and the page you came from
analytics.p2: Declared by the site publisher; Publiable has not checked this service’s documentation.

google.heading: Google (sign in with a Google account) — authentication
google.p1: Data transmitted: your email address, your name
google.p2: Declared by the site publisher; Publiable has not checked this service’s documentation.

rights.heading: Your rights
rights.p1: You can obtain confirmation as to whether data concerning you is being processed and, where that is the case, access it. A copy of this data is provided to you; a reasonable fee based on administrative costs may be charged for any further copies. This right to obtain a copy must not adversely affect the rights and freedoms of others.
rights.p2: You can obtain the rectification of inaccurate data concerning you. Taking into account the purposes of the processing, you can also have incomplete data completed, including by providing a supplementary statement.
rights.p3: You can obtain the erasure of data concerning you where one of the grounds provided for in Article 17 applies, in particular where the data is no longer necessary for the purposes for which it was collected, or where you withdraw your consent and there is no other legal ground. This right does not apply to the extent that the processing remains necessary, in particular for compliance with a legal obligation or for the establishment, exercise or defence of legal claims.
rights.p4: You can obtain the restriction of processing in the situations provided for in Article 18, in particular where you contest the accuracy of the data, for the period needed to verify it, or where you have objected to the processing, pending the examination of your objection.
rights.p5: You can receive the data you have provided in a structured, commonly used and machine-readable format, and transmit it to another controller.
rights.p6: Where data concerning you is rectified or erased, or its processing restricted, each recipient to whom this data has been disclosed is informed, unless this proves impossible or involves disproportionate effort. You can ask to be told who these recipients are.
rights.p7: Where processing is based on your consent, you can withdraw it at any time. This withdrawal does not affect the lawfulness of processing based on consent before its withdrawal.
rights.p8: Where there are reasonable doubts about the identity of the person making the request, additional information necessary to confirm that identity may be requested.
rights.p9: An answer is sent to you without undue delay and in any event within one month of receipt of your request. This period may be extended by two further months, taking into account the complexity and number of requests; you are then informed of the extension and the reasons for the delay within one month.
rights.p10: Exercising these rights is free of charge. Where a request is manifestly unfounded or excessive, in particular because of its repetitive character, a reasonable fee may be charged or the request may be refused; it is then for the controller to demonstrate its manifestly unfounded or excessive character.
rights.p11: If no action is taken on your request, you are informed without delay and at the latest within one month of its receipt, of the reasons for not taking action and of the possibility of lodging a complaint with a supervisory authority and seeking a judicial remedy.

objection.heading: Your right to object
objection.p1: You can object at any time, on grounds relating to your particular situation, to the processing of data concerning you that is based on legitimate interest.

complaint.heading: Complaint
complaint.p1: Without prejudice to any other administrative or judicial remedy, you can lodge a complaint with a supervisory authority if you consider that the processing of data concerning you infringes the regulation. You can in particular contact the authority of the Member State of your habitual residence, your place of work, or the place of the alleged infringement.
complaint.p2: The publisher’s supervisory authority — Autorité de protection des données (APD), Rue de la Presse 35, 1000 Brussels — <url>https://www.autoriteprotectiondonnees.be/citoyen/agir/introduire-une-plainte</url>

extras.heading: Additional information from the publisher
extras.p1: Ankora does not connect to any bank (no PSD2 aggregation). You enter your bills and expenses yourself.
extras.p2: Deleted account: effective deletion 14 days after your request (cancellable grace period).

security.heading: Security
security.p1: Encryption in transit (TLS 1.3) and at rest.
security.p2: Supabase Row Level Security on every table.
security.p3: Rate limiting, strict CSP, append-only audit log.
security.p4: Authentication with a strong password + MFA available.

changes.heading: Changes
changes.p1: Any significant change to this policy is announced on this page, with its date, and by email to people who have an account.

cookies.metaDescription: Ankora's cookie policy: essential cookies, audience measurement on consent, how to change your mind.
cookies.title: Cookie policy
cookies.languageNotice: Diese Richtlinie ist vorerst nur auf Französisch und Englisch verfügbar.
cookies.essentialBody: Required for the app to work: your sign-in session, your language and your theme. They need no consent.
cookies.essentialItem1: sb-…-auth-token — your Supabase sign-in session, set only when you sign in.
cookies.essentialItem4: On your device (local storage, not a cookie): ankora.consent.v1 keeps your audience measurement choice, theme your display preference.
cookies.analyticsBody1: Only if you accept: Vercel Web Analytics (pages viewed) and Vercel Speed Insights (page load times). Vercel states that neither sets a cookie.
cookies.analyticsBody2: Ankora does not use Google Analytics.
cookies.marketingBody: Ankora uses no marketing cookie or tracker.
cookies.manageBody1: You can change your mind at any time in Settings → Cookies & privacy, or with the “Manage cookie preferences” link in the footer.
cookies.manageBody2: Refusing audience measurement changes nothing in the app: Ankora stays fully functional.
cookies.manageMethod1: On your first visit, a bar at the top of the page offers two choices of equal weight: refuse, or accept audience measurement.
cookies.manageMethod2: Signed in, in Settings → Cookies & privacy, you can turn audience measurement on or off.
cookies.manageMethod3: From any page, the “Manage cookie preferences” link in the footer reopens the bar.
cookies.withdrawalBody: Under the GDPR (Art. 7(3)), withdrawing your consent is as easy as giving it. Three equivalent ways: 1) Settings → Cookies & privacy → “Reset my choice”. 2) Footer → “Manage cookie preferences”. 3) Email {email} with the subject “Cookie consent withdrawal”.
cookies.lifetimeItem1: Sign-in session: 400 days at most (the Supabase library default).
cookies.lifetimeItem3: Audience measurement: no cookie; measurement data is kept for six months (see the privacy policy).
